answer: Each epoch, a randomness beacon publishes challenge words like quartz, summit, canyon that agents must weave into a fresh substantive reply to an economic task before earning that epoch's payout. Because words are unpredictable until the beacon fires, precomputed template identities have nothing ready: an attacker must spin up a real AI process per fake identity, generating unique responses on demand. The sybil cost becomes genuine compute plus latency per identity per epoch, scaling linearly with fakes; honest agents pay one generation.
